confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Thai provincial pricing, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately confident. Cocktail and wine_glass are less certain and were set from the local beer relationship (roughly 2.5x and 4x beer) because direct knowledge is weak. Accommodation anchors are the least certain, since Ayutthaya lodging varies widely by season and location. Prices assume about 33 THB per USD and a July 2026 window. The FX value came from a search-result summary that attributes 0.6955 to the RBA Exchange Rates Overview page for 15 October 2026. I did not open that page directly, so verify against the RBA table before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is regional Thailand rather than Bangkok: smaller Thai provincial heritage towns with domestic tourism, such as Lopburi and Kanchanaburi, with prices set below Bangkok levels.
